hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A queen can move horizontally, vertically, or diagonally in a single move unless blocked by an obstacle.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: If the queen is already on the target square, zero moves are required.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Check whether target is aligned along the queen's line of sight without the obstacle standing between them.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Closed-form geometric checks and collinearity line tests run in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search over the chessboard is redundant when closed formulas apply.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies line-of-sight conditions and collinear blocking logic.
